# Analysis digest (auto-generated by scripts/digest.py)

All numbers derived from public data collected 2026-09-25. Views = public Instagram topic-page counts (rounded as displayed). topic_index = views ÷ median views of the same topic page (1.0 = typical). vpf = views ÷ followers (followers at fetch). adj_factor = views relative to expectation for the account's follower count on the same topic page (within-topic regression of log views on log followers; 1.0 = as expected, 2.0 = twice). Segments with n<15 are low confidence.
